note: The graded episode service (graded_server.py). cell: the furniture cell's configuration, the offline grading run's budgets (as the practice lab's lab_config.json): simulated-time cap, camera frames, ticks per step call, settle time before t = 0; program_time_cap_s and silence_s only appear in describe(): the graded episode has no program-time cap and no silence rule (the simulation advances only inside the agent's own requests). prep_s = the task's agent budget on main (the start must come within it of the service's first start); graded_s = the graded window from the start, the contract's default of 3 h (the cell's own work for a whole episode at its bounds, 1500 s simulated and 900 frames, is about 25 min here; the reference assembler's episode takes about 5 min). request_cap_s bounds one request (a hang ends the worker and with it the episode); privileged_request_cap_s the oracle's one reference_assemble request.
